company.summary: ORKEL AS is a private limited company (aksjeselskap) registered under produksjon av jordbruks- og skogbruksmaskiner (NACE 28.300), based in Orkland, founded 2002-08-13. Its verified website describes it as: “Bale anything The Orkel baler-wrapper combinations are currently baling more than 30 different materials within the waste, industry and agricultural sectors, and still expanding to new areas of use. Take a look at some of the materials below! Do not hesitate to contact us to find” Public brand: Orkel. Registered activity: Produksjon og salg av maskiner og redskaper. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, company accounts): revenue NOK 150.4 m, operating result NOK 1.4 m, net result NOK -915.0 k, total assets NOK 154.2 m, equity NOK 74.7 m. The period closed with a loss. Change from 2024 to 2025: revenue went from NOK 143.7 m to NOK 150.4 m (+5%); net result went from NOK -12.4 m to NOK -915.0 k; equity went from NOK 64.4 m to NOK 74.7 m (+16%). Financial position in 2025: operating margin 1.0%; equity ratio 48.4%. Calculated from the filed figures above. Registered employees: 63. Leadership in the official register: Erlend Johan Gjønnes (managing director); Frode Størdal (chair of the board); Miriam Irene Gjønnes Karterud (board member); Gjermund Arne Kambestad (board member); plus 5 further roles. 1 registered workplace in Fannrem. Official website https://www.orkel.com (identity check: full name domain and registered operating head); company-linked profiles on facebook, instagram, linkedin, youtube. Latest company-published activity: “40 years of round bale technology – from one simple idea to a global solution” (2026-10-13). Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-11-12). Not established from checked sources: active job ads (not available). Missing information is not treated as zero.
